info.name: CYCLES_SHADER_XML
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: Cycles shader graphs as XML text for lights and for the world, in the dialect of the 'cyclesXml' material (CYCLES_MATERIAL_CYCLES_XML): one <shader> element with node elements named after the Cycles node type, <socket name value/> children and <connect from_node from_socket to_node to_socket/> elements; the output node is addressed as 'output'. Images are ANARI_SAMPLER parameters of any name holding an 'image2D' sampler: an image_texture or environment_texture node whose 'filename' equals the name of such a parameter samples the array of that sampler. A graph is parsed again only when its text or an image it uses changed. Lights: 'source' is the shader of the light, an emission closure connected to the surface of the output node. It replaces the built-in emission shader (and an 'intensityDistribution'); the strength of the light (color, intensity, power, radiance, irradiance) still scales it. A text that cannot be used reports an error and the light keeps its built-in shader. Renderer: 'backgroundSource' is the world shader, a background closure ('background_shader' node) connected to the surface of the output node. It lights the scene and is what camera rays see, instead of 'ambientRadiance'/'ambientColor' and the 'background' color, and is importance sampled. A 'background' that is an image or a color with alpha < 1 is still composited under the frame: camera rays then do not see the world shader, which keeps lighting the scene. An 'hdri' or 'sky' light of the world takes the background instead of 'backgroundSource'. A text that cannot be used reports an error, 'background' and the ambient light apply then.
